summary: Two List sharing/allocation comments overstate copying; the remaining reviewed additions are sound and comment-only.

items.issue: The comment says only `prefix` is copied, but `prefix: List` with an empty receiver is returned unchanged by `xs ::: this`, and the `ListBuffer`/empty-receiver branch returns `b.toList` without copying its internal list.
items.suggestion: Describe copying conditionally: construction copies prefix elements when needed, while a List prefix or an empty receiver can be returned/shared directly.

items.issue: The comment says kept elements are copied, but `slice` delegates to `drop(...).take(...)`; when `until` reaches past the end, `take` returns the dropped suffix itself, sharing it with the original list.
items.suggestion: State that the kept elements are copied only when the slice ends before the source suffix; otherwise the whole selected suffix may be returned unchanged.
